draft.emotion: wistful and calm, gazing up at a quiet night sky
notes: Counted with the measure word 颗 (kē), e.g., 一颗星星 (a star).
星星 is the everyday word for stars seen in the night sky; the single character 星 (xīng) is used in compounds and scientific contexts (like 行星 'planet').
